capabilities: Convert vault PDFs to Markdown via right-click or command palette
Extract text and detect simple tables as Markdown or SVG
Extract and compress embedded images as WebP, JPEG, or PNG
Preview rendered output and output paths before saving
Update links to the source PDF and trash or move the original
disambiguation: It does not perform OCR; scanned or image-only PDFs are kept as compressed page images unless they already contain a text layer.
extras: The README explicitly lists limitations (no OCR, no guaranteed layout recovery) and privacy guarantees (no network requests, no analytics). Includes manual installation steps and a 0.1.x-to-0.2.0 upgrade guide; see PRIVACY.md for privacy details.
intentEvidence: Version 0.2.0 is a complete native rewrite of the earlier desktop-only plugin.
motivation: The 0.2.0 version is a complete native rewrite of the earlier desktop-only build to remove the Python runtime and external staging folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn PDF files into editable Markdown notes, and existing converters rely on Python, terminal commands, or external services.
summary: PDF-to-Markdown converter that extracts text, tables, and images locally using Obsidian's own PDF engine, with no Python or network access.
